In the background, there are multi-story urban buildings with air conditioners and a red and white 'Synology' brand sign. The lighting is bright, natural daylight under an overcast sky. (2) As the camera pans slightly right, we see a black tent canopy covering tables stacked with numerous boxed products, likely hobby kits or models. The child remains centered, laughing joyfully. Many adult males are visible in the background, observing the scene or looking at products. (3) The panning motion continues, revealing more of the street-level market atmosphere. People are wearing casual clothing like t-shirts and polo shirts. The foreground is filled with the edges of display tables and the crowd. Yellow text overlays are consistently present at the bottom of the frame throughout these transitions.
